verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government service portal, so asking whether its published sign-in path uses remotely completable credential MFA is a fair question. The evidence pack only covers informational content (migration, integration, asylum, statistics) and says nothing about any sign-in, MFA, or identity-verification method. Absence of evidence for an applicable axis is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
